Home grouped by app, within each day

The demo’s Saturday, all 53 things from 37 apps, drawn three ways at the feed’s real sizes (30pt marks, 44pt row head, the pink day). Marks are the app’s own brand-* icons or its BridgeGlyph fallback. Inside a group the things stay newest first, and the apps are ordered by their newest thing, so the day still reads top-down in time.
